visualCharacteristics: Horizontal tab bar with an active-tab underline organizing several content panels (e.g. About BD / Segments / Leadership / Board of Directors). Only the active panel is visible.
contentPattern: Repeating rows; each row's first cell is the tab title and the remaining cell is that tab's panel content.
usage: Primary content navigator on the about-bd-3 template pages, grouping intro copy, values, history, honors, segments and leadership grids into tabs.
